summary: Local neural TTS engine exposed through a Python package, CLI, C/C++ API and web server. It embeds espeak-ng for phonemization and synthesizes audio from separately obtained ONNX voice models. Its strength is a fast local workflow with many community voices and multiple language phonemizers; voice licensing is model-specific.
use_when: Synthesize speech locally through a CLI or Python pipeline with supported Piper voices
Use instead of hosted TTS when local inference and voice choice matter
avoid_when: Use Kokoro ONNX for its specific voice/model family and permissive code licence
Use hosted speech services when a voice’s model card or GPL code terms do not fit
license: GPL-3.0-or-later (engine); each voice model has its own MODEL_CARD licence; bundled phonemizer resources may carry separate terms

install.macos: python3 -m pip install piper-tts; download a voice model and its JSON config

assessment.rationale: Piper v1.8.0 released 2026-09-04 with active release work, though upstream explicitly seeks maintainers. The engine is GPL-3.0-or-later; project makes no licence grant for voice models, whose MODEL_CARD terms must be checked individually. Embeds espeak-ng.
